text: The door was opened carefully on the chain, and inside the bright hall all the servants stood huddled together like a flock of frightened sheep. <break time="0.8s" /> At the sight of Utterson, the housemaid burst into tears, while the cook cried out, Bless God, it is Mister Utterson. <break time="0.8s" /> Poole took a candle and led the lawyer through the garden into the laboratory, where a flight of stairs led up to the cabinet door. <break time="0.8s" /> Come as quietly as you can, sir, whispered Poole, and if by any chance he asks you in, do not go. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he climbed the steps and knocked with an unsteady hand, calling out, Mister Utterson, sir, asking to see you. <break time="0.8s" /> A voice from inside answered in a complaining tone, Tell him I cannot see anyone, and Poole led the lawyer back to the kitchen. <break time="0.8s" /> Sir, said Poole, looking him in the eye, was that my masters voice, and Utterson, turning very pale, answered that it seemed much changed. <break time="0.8s" /> Changed, Have I been twenty years in this mans house to be fooled about his voice, cried Poole, his voice trembling with emotion. <break time="0.8s" /> No, sir, my master was done away with eight days ago, when we heard him cry out upon the name of God.
